cat > /tmp/gen_fig1_taxonomy.py << 'PYEOF'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

# Layout
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))
ax.set_xlim(0, 7)
ax.set_ylim(0, 3.8)
ax.axis('off')

# Grid dimensions
col_label_w = 0.15   # left margin for row labels (fraction of total)
row_label_h = 0.18   # top margin for col labels (fraction of total)

# Actual cell grid coordinates
x_start = 1.9
y_start = 0.3
cell_w = 1.6
cell_h = 0.85
n_cols = 3
n_rows = 3

# Column headers
col_headers = [
    'Decomposed\n(BCE)',
    'Intermediate\n(MSE)',
    'Coupled\n(KL)',
]

# Row headers
row_headers = [
    'Per-token\nContextual',
    'Per-layer',
    'Static',
]

# Cell contents: [row][col], row 0 = top (Per-token Contextual), row 2 = bottom (Static)
cells = [
    ['FastForward\nDejaVu', '—', 'Ours'],
    ['—', 'ShadowLLM', '—'],
    ['—', '—', 'SPON'],
]

# Colors
ours_bg = '#D4E6F1'       # light blue for "Ours"
filled_bg = '#F0F0F0'     # light gray for occupied cells
empty_bg = '#FAFAFA'       # near-white for empty cells
header_bg = '#E8E8E8'     # header background
ours_border = '#2471A3'   # bold blue border for Ours
grid_color = '#AAAAAA'
header_text_color = '#222222'

# Draw column headers
for j in range(n_cols):
    x = x_start + j * cell_w
    y = y_start + n_rows * cell_h
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), cell_w, 0.65,
                           boxstyle="square,pad=0",
                           facecolor=header_bg, edgecolor=grid_color, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x + cell_w / 2, y + 0.325, col_headers[j],
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color=header_text_color)

# Draw row headers
for i in range(n_rows):
    x = 0.15
    y = y_start + (n_rows - 1 - i) * cell_h
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), x_start - x, cell_h,
                           boxstyle="square,pad=0",
                           facecolor=header_bg, edgecolor=grid_color, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x + (x_start - x) / 2, y + cell_h / 2, row_headers[i],
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color=header_text_color)

# Draw cells
for i in range(n_rows):
    for j in range(n_cols):
        x = x_start + j * cell_w
        y = y_start + (n_rows - 1 - i) * cell_h
        content = cells[i][j]

        # Choose style
        if content == 'Ours':
            bg = ours_bg
            lw = 2.5
            ec = ours_border
        elif content == '—':
            bg = empty_bg
            lw = 0.8
            ec = grid_color
        else:
            bg = filled_bg
            lw = 0.8
            ec = grid_color

        rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), cell_w, cell_h,
                               boxstyle="square,pad=0",
                               facecolor=bg, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

        # Text
        if content == 'Ours':
            # Star + bold
            ax.text(x + cell_w / 2, y + cell_h / 2,
                    '★ Ours',
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12,
                    fontweight='bold', color='#1A5276')
        elif content == '—':
            ax.text(x + cell_w / 2, y + cell_h / 2,
                    '—',
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11,
                    color='#CCCCCC')
        else:
            ax.text(x + cell_w / 2, y + cell_h / 2,
                    content,
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10,
                    color='#333333', style='italic')

# Axis dimension labels
# X-axis label
ax.text(x_start + n_cols * cell_w / 2, y_start + n_rows * cell_h + 0.65 + 0.22,
        'Training Signal Coupling',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        color='#333333')

# Y-axis label
ax.text(-0.15, y_start + n_rows * cell_h / 2,
        'Correction\nGranularity',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        color='#333333', rotation=90)

# Arrow annotations for axes (subtle)
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
# X arrow (left to right under column headers)
ax.annotate('', xy=(x_start + n_cols * cell_w - 0.05, y_start + n_rows * cell_h + 0.72),
            xytext=(x_start + 0.05, y_start + n_rows * cell_h + 0.72),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.2))

# Y arrow (bottom to top, left of row headers)
ax.annotate('', xy=(0.05, y_start + n_rows * cell_h - 0.05),
            xytext=(0.05, y_start + 0.05),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.2))

# Top-left corner cell (header intersection)
rect = FancyBboxPatch((0.15, y_start + n_rows * cell_h), x_start - 0.15, 0.65,
                       boxstyle="square,pad=0",
                       facecolor='#DDDDDD', edgecolor=grid_color, linewidth=0.8)
ax.add_patch(rect)

# Save
outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_14/projects/distill_sparse_swiglu/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig1_overview.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig1_overview.png')
plt.close()
print('Done')
